item.title: GTA 6 Players Are Encountering a Mysterious Game Breaking Crash
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is somehow off to an even hotter start than many expected. The game sold 32.5 million copies pre-release , bringing in a whopping $3.79 billion on day one. That makes it the biggest entertainment launch in history, according to publisher Take-Two. Unfortunately, though, not everyone has been able to enjoy the fun. Numerous players have reported that they can't progress in the game due to a persistent PlayStation 5 crash that sends them back to the dashboard.

item.title: The Best GTA 6 Easter Eggs We’ve Seen So Far
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally in the wild, and there are a mind-boggling number of things to do in Leonida. Many of them are terribly dangerous, like stealing cars from the police impound lot, getting into high-speed chases, and laundering stolen goods. But GTA 6 has plenty of wild and wacky optional activities too, many of which include references to pop-culture icons, past Rockstar games, or well-known memes. Here are a few of the coolest Easter eggs we've discovered in our own playthroughs and from other players on social media.

item.title: GTA 6 Official Sales Numbers Are In — And They're Unbelievable
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is off to a staggering start mere days into its release. Rockstar Games and Grand Theft Auto publisher Take-Two Interactive announced Friday that GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies during its pre-release period — a new record across all platforms, Take-Two says — and generated $3.79 billion in revenue.

item.title: New Lucario 'Pokémon' Set Quietly Changes Everything For TCG Fans
item.description: After weeks of apparent early sales leaks , The Pokémon Company just revealed its slate of products for the upcoming Flowing Fists Pokémon Trading Card Game expansion set. The fighting-themed set looks like a banger based on early card reveals , which feature fan-favorite monsters and art by popular illustrators . TCG fans shouldn't get too wrapped up in the pretty pictures or shiny wrappers, though: there's an important asterisk to the news that will impact the hobby at large.

item.title: How to change time in GTA 6
item.description: Being able to change time in Grand Theft Auto 6 is quite helpful, as you can only start some missions at a certain time of day. Progressing through the campaign is not the only reason to do so. Some businesses are open only for a period of the day, like the bank, for example.

item.title: Sega Officially Reveals Huge Black Friday Sale
item.description: Black Friday seems to get earlier and earlier every year. A week before the main festivities, Sega has launched its Black Friday 2026 sale , featuring discounts of up to 80% on certain titles. The sale is running across the Epic Games Store, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Steam, and Xbox — and it includes Sega and Atlus franchises such as Sonic the Hedgehog, Persona, and Like A Dragon.

item.title: Fortune and Cursed treasure hours schedule in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite is continuing the tradition of special Saturday hourly events during the Chapter 7 mini season , though this time they're treasure hours , centered around the pirate-themed "Treasure Hunters" season. During these hours, certain sprites will get increased drop rates, and you'll drop into the game with special items.

item.title: GTA 6's Autosave Is Ruining The Game, But Not For The Reason You Think
item.description: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 might be the best-rated game of all time , but that doesn't mean players love every single thing about the open-world shooter. Some drawbacks, like the game's wonky controls, can be adjusted. Others, players are simply stuck with. One of the biggest complaints is that GTA 6 's autosave feature simply isn't good enough.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Have Already Discovered an Infinite Money Glitch
item.description: Many players have a habit of optimizing the fun out of video games, and that tendency has unsurprisingly found its way into Grand Theft Auto 6 . Apparently, the game has many ways to “get rich quick,” and these exploitive strategies are going viral online.
